text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way back from an outing<n>with Seeking
the Pearl when she<n>suddenly stops dead in her
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeeew, BANG!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...! Was that a firework?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Did you just let off a<n>firework?!

Hm? Yeah... I did. It's one of my own<n>creations. I let
it off as a test run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you're a fireworks<n>maker?!
That's amazing! Can you<n>show us more of them?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The old man we bump into turns out<n>to be a
firework craftsman who owns<n>a workspace
nearby. Apparently, he<n>often holds workshop
where kids can<n>try making their own fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
I'll be holding a workshop again<n>soon, so I'm
trying out various<n>prototypes to show to the kids.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A workshop... How exciting! Do you<n>have more
fireworks on you right<n>now?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Sure do. I got loads. Do you two want<n>to try making
something?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
That's it. Make sure it's firmly<n>attached to the
bamboo stake since<n>that's what determines the
propulsive force of the rocket.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how you make sure it<n>flies straight
up... There! Time to try<n>launching it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whiiiz, BANG!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It worked! I mean, did it?! Was<n>that a successful
shot?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Very good! Considering it was your<n>first attempt,
you did really well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl looks like she's<n>having a great
time. It's rare to see<n>her filled with such childlike
delight,<n>and I can't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
By the by, you wouldn't happen to<n>have any good
ideas for a new<n>creation would ya?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
I want to make more fireworks that<n>kids'll enjoy,
but honestly, I've hit a<n>wall. I'd love to get some
fresh ideas<n>from a young'un like you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about making a whistling<n>rocket that
sounds like it's playing<n>dance music while it's
flying into the<n>air?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A firework that creates an image or a<n>shape in the
sky might be fun, too!<n>Like if it makes a star when it
explodes!

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Haha, those do sound interesting! But<n>a firework
that plays music would be<n>tricky to construct.
Perhaps with a<n>little creativity, we could make
something along those lines, though.

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
...All right, let's give it a shot. We can<n>at least get it
to produce a rhythmic<n>beat, and getting it to make a
simple<n>star shape won't be hard either.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! I wonder if I can really<n>make a firework
that explodes into a<n>star in the sky... Are we going
to use<n>chemicals that burn in different colors<n>to
make this work?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
You got it. You can make any color<n>you like using
this flame colorant. You<n>can't make a star with just
one<n>firework, though. You'll have to make<n>a ton of
different types, including a<n>mix of fountain
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's get cracking, then! Time to<n>churn out a bunch
of fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...All right! It's ready! Here's another<n>fountain
firework! That's the third<n>one.
choice_data_list:
You're really making progress! What color is the
one you just made?

You're really making progress! What color is the
one you just made?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That one's yellow! I already did red<n>and orange
earlier, so what color<n>should I make next?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You've got really good taste! Let's fill<n>the sky with
a fiery star that sparkles<n>with a warm-toned
gradient!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh, it's so tough trying to make<n>the fireworks
explode at a steady<n>rhythm...

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
You're on the right track, though! You<n>just need to
adjust the length of the<n>fuse a little more, and...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I-I think I did it! I made a collection of<n>fireworks
that'll create a star in the<n>sky and play a rhythm
you can dance<n>to when it explodes!

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Righty-o, let's hurry and try it out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whiiiiiz, BANG, BANG, BANG!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Both the beat and star pattern<n>in the sky are
so awe-inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fantastic! What a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, this really is<n>something! I've never
seen anything<n>like it!
choice_data_list: You really love firework rockets, don't you?
You really love firework rockets, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, this really is<n>something! I've never
seen anything<n>like it!
choice_data_list: You really love firework rockets, don't you?
You really love firework rockets, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I honestly never knew firework<n>rockets were
hiding this many<n>possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to make even more of them!<n>Would that be
okay? Please say yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl appears to be<n>entirely hooked on
making fireworks.<n>It's not often she gets so eager
about things.
choice_data_list:
Sure. You can come back for one of his workshops
sometime.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're coming too then,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Making fireworks was obviously<n>super exciting, but
the real reason I<n>was so focused and had so much
fun<n>was because you were with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I do. Setting off rocket fireworks is<n>such a lively and
positive activity.<n>Doesn't it just make your heart
race?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Every burst feels as though it's<n>cheering me on,
boosting my<n>determination to seek more
possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's why I like them so much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I wish I could stay here and<n>enjoy both this
view and this<n>rhythmic booming forever...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's profile is limned<n>by the
fireworks' light and her own<n>bright smile as she
murmurs that. It<n>warms my heart to know I was
able<n>to let her experience something so<n>fun.
